workflow.title: Mac diagnostics or storage investigation? Choose the next check before resetting caches
workflow.intent: Triage a Mac maintenance question into hardware-health testing, system-service maintenance or storage-owner investigation without treating every symptom as a reason to clear caches.
workflow.track: practical decision workflow, documentary not hands-on
outline: Conclusion: diagnosis and storage accounting answer different questions
State the symptom and retain a backup before maintenance
Use Techtool Lite's documented internal-drive, memory or battery checks for diagnostic questions
Separate database/cache refresh from finding large or recurring folders
Use Breathing Room, which we build, only for the bounded storage/activity branch with preview and hosted-AI caveats
Record results and escalate unresolved diagnostic issues rather than promising a reset fixes them
workflow.interaction: Non-destructive three-branch checklist: hardware-health concern, database/service malfunction, or unexplained storage growth. It recommends an investigation category, not a diagnosis or automatic deletion.
workflow.visualPlacement: After lead: Techtool Lite official UI only once rights cleared; later: selected Space example preview. Do not substitute icons for app view.
workflow.differentiation: Not a Techtool Pro repair/recovery or external-drive article; no named database-reset tutorial without additional official procedure evidence.
